title: Firewall log analysis (KQL)
description: Analyzes Azure Firewall logs to identify blocked traffic patterns, top talkers, and potential misconfigurations.
example_prompt: "Query Azure Firewall diagnostic logs for the last 24 hours. Show: (1) top 20 denied flows by count, (2) denied flows where source is an internal subnet (potential misconfiguration), (3) allowed flows to suspicious destinations, (4) traffic volume by rule collection."
